_note: The greenhouse inside (Hachiro builds it: data/shops.json builds greenhouse; FarmGrid.GREENHOUSE outside). A glasshouse of our own: a timber frame glazed all round (walls: glass), a gravel walk along the back and the front, and four rows of eight beds between them. `plots` is the part of the map that is a FarmGrid of its own (Game.greenhouse, sheltered: any seed grows in any season, no rain waters it, no storm, snow or weeds reach it; the can does the watering). Its cells are the beds; the farmer walks on them as on the field. The water tub at the back right fills the watering can (use water); the potting bench at the back left is only to look at. The clock stands still in here like in every building.
name: Greenhouse

props.message: Seed trays and a trowel. Under the glass, any seed takes.
